# Request for Comments (RFCs)

RFCs are detailed technical specifications for major features.

**Gateway Simplification** (RFC-063 through RFC-066):
- **RFC-063**: Normative proxy auth contract
- Work status: the infrastructure plan tracks the active implementation
- See also: [MEMO-099](/memos/memo-099) for the review

**Reusable Namespace Authoring** (RFC-067):
- Defines a reusable authoring format
